title: Uppestcase and Lowestcase Letters  [advances in derp learning]
summary: Tom Scott-style absurdist research by tom7 for SIGBOVIK 2021, using machine learning to discover letterforms that are 'uppercaser' than uppercase A and lowercaser than lowercase. It is a comedic, technically inventive deep dive with fonts and a paper.
why: Tom7 is an HN favorite, and this video is praised as hilarious, educational silly ML that keeps getting better.

quote.text: it just keeps getting better and better as the video progresses. I laughed so hard.
